title: Building Operations Director
text:
As one of the nation’s premier private athletic clubs and a Seattle institution, The Washington Athletic Club (WAC) is not simply a place to work, but a place to belong. The WAC features extensive amenities, such as fitness centers, a stunning pool, three restaurants, a hotel, a spa, banquet halls, and more. Built in 1930, our beautifully maintained 21-story building in downtown Seattle has landmark status.

The WAC is seeking individuals who are dedicated to being the best and are willing to embrace the Club’s five core values: Leadership, Excellence, Integrity, Service and Sensitivity.

**OVERVIEW**

The Building Operations Director is responsible for successful leadership and management of all aspects of the WAC’s Building Operations, particularly building maintenance, janitorial, maintenance project planning and management.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage building maintenance programs and initiatives
* Ensure building cleanliness and environmental standards are met; monitor utility usage
* Direct and provide overall supervision to the Chief Engineer and Maintenance team
* Work with the Chief Operating Officer to refine key strategies for success
* Serve as project manager for WAC capital improvement projects
* Work closely with the Building Operations Assistant Manager and Chief Engineer in coordinating and performing preventive maintenance database planning
* Participate in Building and Operations department meetings, including serving as the head of the safety committee
* Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* A minimum of eight (8) years of building management experience in a supervisory capacity
* Bachelor’s degree in Building Management or related field, or equivalent experience
* Strong communication skills and a customer service mindset.

Must have or be able to obtain Osha 30 certification.

**BENEFIT INFORMATION**

* Benefit package for full-time team members: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability insurance
* Paid Time Off (PTO) – accrues at a rate of .0519 hours per hours worked to a maximum of 108 hours per year
* 9 paid holidays per year
* 401(K) with employer match
* Employee Assistance Program
* ORCA Passport Program
* Pet insurance available
* Free daily meal (soup/salad bar)
* Discount on spa services and products
